method: Two whole sentences cut from Gutenberg by boundary strings, whitespace normalized. Maker originally examined the fifth impression (1964); a separate research reader compared both passages with the 1915 copy, 1964 copy and French 1912 p. 56. Kit review and scoped rights assessment pending.
